script_text: Aries, fire sign ruled by Mars, something shifts under your skin this week. Early week, the Sun in your 8th House squares Mars conjunct Jupiter in Leo, your 5th House, so Monday brings money tension and ego clashes, while Wednesday's Mercury in your 9th House trines that same bold pair, sharpening every pitch. The turning point arrives Thursday as Venus sextiles the Sun from your 10th House, turning shared money and someone else's resources into real offers. Love flares too: attached Aries gets one honest conversation, singles meet someone truly creative. By the weekend, Uranus trine Pluto ignites your 3rd and 11th Houses, so one simple message becomes your next big opening. Wednesday is your power day because Mercury trines Mars-Jupiter in your romance house. Saturday is your risk day — never sign anything impulsively. Tip: lead with curiosity, not conquest. Follow for daily cosmic updates.
